This feature is a hallmark of IDH-mutant astrocytomas. Supporting this are other features typical of IDH-mutant gliomas, including minimal contrast enhancement (`Proportion Enhancing` of 0.02) and limited surrounding edema (`ED Volume (mL)` of 9.434). The main contradicting feature is the very high `Proportion Necrosis` (73.84%), which is more typical of IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. However, given the lack of enhancement, this likely represents a non-enhancing cystic or necrotic core rather than the classic tumor necrosis seen in glioblastoma, and is a common finding in IDH-mutant astrocytomas. The sharp tumor boundary (`Transition Zone Thickness (FLAIR)` median 0.75 mm) is also somewhat atypical but does not outweigh the powerful T2-FLAIR mismatch evidence.
